description: This PHP class defines a REST API endpoint for retrieving various time reports within an HR management system. It maps report types to specific report classes and provides a method to instantiate and return the appropriate report based on query input. It includes detailed annotations for API documentation and handles validation for report type requests.

classes.name: TimeReportAPI
classes.description: A REST API class for fetching different types of time reports such as project, activity detailed, employee, and attendance reports within the HR system.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Returns an instance of the report class corresponding to the report name query parameter, validating its existence and throwing an exception if invalid.
